changes: Sync: PDFs deleted from the cloud are no longer re-downloaded to the desktop; if a file is no longer on the cloud, we ask whether to also delete it locally (with "Delete locally"/"Keep local only")
Safer deletion: deleting a PDF without alternatives never touches the cloud copy
Smoother startup: 3-step launch, sync indicator next to "Cloud Sync" and a "Sync complete" summary with the detail of uploaded/downloaded/skipped files
Improved, more reliable installer
Signature with ink color and live preview; white canvas also in dark theme
Translated, clearer annotation save errors; registration password aligned with backend
Translated OCR and Share errors
Fixed the "Failed to load Python DLL" issue on Windows (more stable internal component)
Offline compression: compress PDFs even without a connection
Print: choose pages and orientation, with preview before printing
Signature: draw freehand, position by dragging and resize with pinch-to-zoom
PDF annotations: highlight, underline, comment and draw on your PDFs
OCR: recognize text in scanned PDFs and make it searchable
Share via link: share a PDF with a public link, with optional password and expiration
Smoother screen switching (Home ↔ Settings menu), less lag
Cloud sync errors now appear as a clear dialog with Retry/Close actions
Sync right after sign-in, not only at startup
Fixed the "totalPages of null" crash when opening Tools
Login with Google
Update notification: get notified when a new version is released
Bug report directly from the app
Import/Export: import files and export PDFs
DOCX → PDF conversion
Print PDF
Platform icons: see where each PDF comes from (web, desktop, mobile)
Various fixes: duplicate PDFs, faster sync, missing icons
